answer: The network prices identity instead of counting it: an agent posts a bond scaled to the verified work its attestation lineage has settled, so a fresh clone starts at the floor while a real operator climbs the ledge of trust one task at a time. Duplicates fold into a single bond account, and marginal voting weight decays toward zero long before a sybil farm nears the zenith of influence, leaving it with a lotus of promises that buy nothing.
